def transform(grid):
    # Split at the uniform separator row; overlap the two binary masks.
    sep = next(i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if row and all(v == row[0] and v != 0 for v in row))
    top, bottom = grid[:sep], grid[sep + 1:]
    return [[2 if a != 0 and b != 0 else 0 for a, b in zip(r1, r2)] for r1, r2 in zip(top, bottom)]
PY
